OblivionAngra OSS

An autonomous intelligence system engineered for complex digital work. Not a chatbot: a system that plans, uses tools, and verifies what it did.

Intelligence beyond chat — research build, controlled access

ManifestoRead the figures in order

We do not build assistants.
We build systems.

A model can answer. A system can operate. A workflow can remember. A machine can continue.

Software should not only ask intelligence questions. It should be able to act on the answers, check its own work, and stop when a person says stop.

Intelligence doesn’t have to talk.
It can operate.

System / 01ANGRA OSS

Not chat.
Operation.

A chat turns a question into an answer. ANGRA is designed around an objective: it plans, gathers, acts, and checks before it reports.

Module 05 / Tool layer — legitimate, scoped, auditable

Public-web research is designed with request controls, domain and private-network protection, timeouts, size limits, authorization, rate limiting and audit logs. It does not bypass logins, paywalls, or access controls.
